design_rules: Use the registered probe wrapper exactly and change only the registered peer-information handling state within each pair.
All downstream prompts are standalone forecast episodes. They must not contain a probe suffix, copied stance instruction, generation instruction, or any text after the one response contract.
Use ordinary non-authoritative peers and preserve the registered metadata schedule without naming the construct.

probe_train.instructions: Generate complete matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Keep peers, evidence, entities, and wording identical within a pair except the registered peer-information handling clause inside Scenario; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_validation.instructions: Generate new matched validation probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Change only the registered peer-information handling clause; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_heldout.instructions: Generate held-out matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper and new domains. Change only the registered peer-information handling clause; append nothing after the wrapper.

behavior_eval.instructions: Generate standalone factual forecast items with assigned metadata. Include exactly one probability response contract and no probe suffix, stance instruction, or target label.

steering_eval.instructions: Generate a distinct standalone forecast pool with the same metadata schedule. Include exactly one probability response contract and no probe suffix or target label.

calibration.instructions: Generate neutral standalone forecast items for calibration. Include exactly one probability response contract and no peer-weighting label or probe suffix.
